title: Kiln mod manifest (kiln.mod.json), v2
description: Validated by Kiln.Host at load time and by Kiln.Sdk at build time (managed/Kiln.Host/Manifest.cs is the reference). Comments and trailing commas are allowed. Docs: docs/kiln/modding/manifest.md.

id.description: Unique mod id; also the data folder kiln/data/<id>.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-pre][+build]); 1 and 1.2 are read as 1.0.0 and 1.2.0.

apiVersion.description: Kiln mod API the mod needs. A bare version ("0.2") means that version or any later one with the same major (the API is additive within a major, 0.x included); anything else is a range checked against Kiln.Mods.ApiVersion.

side.description: Where the mod loads; mods for the other side are skipped.

clients.description: What a player's game needs to join a server running this mod: none (vanilla clients join), kiln (Kiln on the client; the server sends the mod's definitions), mod (the mod itself, delivered by the server's modpack). Default from side: server -> none, client and both -> mod.

dependencies.description: Mods (or "kiln", the core version) this mod needs. Required ones load first and must match; optional ones load first when present and must match when present.

loadBefore.description: Load before these mods when they are present (no requirement).

loadAfter.description: Load after these mods when they are present (no requirement).

incompatible.description: This mod does not load when one of these is present (in the given range).

features.description: Kiln features that must be available on this game build (Game.HasFeature), e.g. tick, log.mirror.

entryAssembly.description: The mod's assembly, in the mod folder. Leave it out for a mod of data only (content packs, assets): Kiln loads it with no code to run, so it takes its place in the load order and its data applies.

entryType.description: Full name of the Kiln.Mod subclass (default: the only public one).

exports.description: Assemblies dependents compile against; at run time they get these copies (shared types and state).

advanced.description: Opt into the advanced tier (raw hooks, symbols, coremod-style patches); exposed as ModInfo.Advanced.

writes.description: Component types the mod writes through the game's write tracking (World.Write, World.Update, World.WriteField, World.WriteAt): short names such as Fuel. At most 64 entries, a repeated name counted each time and read once. A value that breaks these rules is not read: the mod still loads (a warning), and each of its tracked writes is refused with what is wrong with the list. kiln.world reads the list when the server starts, because the game fixes a program's access then; a write to a type that is not listed is refused. Kiln.Sdk adds the types the mod's code passes to World.Write<T> and World.Update<T>; list by hand what the code names only as a string.

autoRun.description: Run the [KilnTest] methods when the server has started (and after each reload while it runs).

filter.description: Only tests whose name contains this.

kilnBuild.description: Written by Kiln.Sdk when it builds the mod: {"version", "created"}, the Kiln build of the Kiln.Api it compiled against. Kiln and the launcher compare it with the game's runtime and name a mod built against a newer Kiln (update Kiln on the Runtime page). Leave it out of a hand-written manifest: the build adds it. Never a reason to refuse a mod: a stamp Kiln can't read is ignored with a warning (KL103).

version.description: The build as the runtime bundle names it: <semver>+<yyyymmdd>.<git>, e.g. 0.2.0-dev+20261106.0f0a3f6.

created.description: The commit's time, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (the runtime bundle's created): it orders two builds of one day. Another form is dropped.
